issues.summary: The helper named Single only checked Count>0 and returned the first row, so its name overstated a uniqueness guarantee it did not enforce.
issues.fix: Rename to reflect first-match semantics, or use Assert.Single.
issues.resolution: Renamed the helper Single -> FirstRef (5 call sites updated) with a comment clarifying it returns the first match; the per-identifier resolution claim is what each test asserts.
